notes: Full-time traffic and transport design support (intersections, access roads, car parks). AutoCAD is accepted among the named tools. SEEK apply links out. Fit 75 (50 + 15 duty + 10 lane 1).
cover_letter_text:
Hi Colliers team,

My name's Marc. I hold a Bachelor of Science in Civil Engineering, and in February 2026 I finished an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design. Your engineering and design team works on intersections, access roads and car parks, and I'd like to help with that design and documentation work.

In the diploma I designed road geometry, earthworks and drainage in AutoCAD and Civil 3D, and I studied the Austroads guides. On site in the Philippines I reviewed drawings, did inspections and wrote progress reports.

I'd move to Brisbane and can start three weeks after an offer. I have full working rights in Australia (Subclass 485 visa). Happy to chat any time.

Kind regards,
Marc Masarate
advert_text:
Company Description
Colliers (NASDAQ, TSX: CIGI) is a leading diversified professional services and investment management company. With operations in 64 countries, our 17,000 enterprising professionals work collaboratively to provide expert advice to clients.
The Colliers Engineering and Design team specialises in civil, infrastructure, traffic & transport, water engineering, town planning and urban design. Key services provided to developers in this service line include site assessment and due diligence, planning approvals and engineering design through to completion of construction.
Job Description
his is a fantastic opportunity for an engineer or designer to further develop their technical and project delivery skills within a collaborative and supportive environment.
Working closely with experienced Engineers, Designers, and Project Managers, you will contribute to the design and delivery of transport infrastructure across a range of projects.
Specifically:
- Assist in the design of intersections, access roads, car parks, and service vehicle facilities
- Support the preparation of concept, functional, and detailed designs
- Contribute to technical reports, drawings, and documentation
- Work alongside project teams to support project delivery
- Review drawings and engineering data from internal and external stakeholders
- Build strong working relationships across project teams
- Continue developing your technical capability and industry knowledge
Qualifications
- Tertiary qualification in Civil Engineering (or similar)
- Exposure to transport or civil design (consultancy experience highly regarded)
- Familiarity with design tools such as 12d, AutoCAD, or vehicle tracking software
- Strong communication skills and a collaborative mindset
- Keen to learn, develop, and build a long-term career in engineering
- Ability to manage time effectively and meet project deadlines
Additional Information
At Colliers, we are enterprising. What sets us apart is not what we do, but how we do it. Our people are passionate, take personal responsibility and always do what’s right for our clients, people and communities. We accelerate their success by empowering them to think and act differently to drive exceptional results. 
With circa 9,000 experts in Asia Pacific, our enterprising culture and decentralised operating model allows us to act with speed in local markets, seizing opportunities to innovate and accelerate the success of our clients and our people.
Our collaborative culture sets us apart. We help experts become true specialists and provide the long-term structure and platform to accelerate their success.
We foster an environment in which everyone at Colliers feels respected and comfortable bringing their authentic selves to do their best work. It’s our people who set us apart and we actively recruit people who represent the diversity of the communities in which we operate. We take great pride in doing what’s right and operating in ways that benefit the business, our people, our clients, our communities, and the environment.
Experts join experts, and we welcome you to join us as we lead the industry into the future.
Please apply with your CV or reach out to Jasmine Mims at jasmine.mims@colliers.com for more information.
Please be advised that applications will only be accepted directly rather than via recruitment agencies.
